transforms.name: observed-git
transforms.effect: context_changed with a git root sets branch to a string or null, and detached when a head exists without a branch.

transforms.name: reduce-env
transforms.effect: environment:updated upserts cwd and git. Partial merge keeps an omitted git when cwd alone changes.

transforms.name: derive-branch
transforms.effect: A nonempty observed branch wins, else host fallback, else observed null, else workspace branch.
